scope: M7 only; additive clinical design specification

requiredness.R: Required structure/slot. Datum and ClinicalTime can explicitly be non-known. Does not imply clinician manual entry.
requiredness.C: Conditional field required under stated predicate. Implement exact machine predicate and tests before acceptance.

primitives.Identifier: Scoped nonempty opaque string; versioned transport limits.
primitives.String: Bounded UTF-8 safely rendered text; no executable instruction authority.
primitives.Enum: Closed per-field discriminator values in definition; source unrecognized code remains raw with unsupported status.
primitives.T: Generic type parameter fixed by enclosing Datum field; never arbitrary untyped clinical JSON.
primitives.Decimal: Finite base-10 lexical string, never binary float/bool/NaN/infinity.
primitives.Instant: Offset-aware ISO8601 instant with exact source precision retained; M7 timestamp admission restrictions still apply.
primitives.Integer: Strict integer, no bool/float coercion; counts nonnegative under field predicate.

validation_profiles.title: Ownership and authorization
validation_profiles.requirements: Validate authenticated scope, exact patient/encounter/device assignment, cross-encounter grants and external directory references. Reject foreign data without PHI leakage.

validation_profiles.title: Exact references and revisions
validation_profiles.requirements: Per-field target-kind/scope allowlists, exact immutable revisions/digests, successor semantics, unresolved lineage and association-versus-derivation cycles. Reverse lists are projections.

validation_profiles.title: Typed unknowns and conditionals
validation_profiles.requirements: Required slot does not require fabricated known value. Enforce Datum known-value union, clinical-time discriminators and all conditional fields; nonknown values never zero/normal.

validation_profiles.title: Timestamp fidelity
validation_profiles.requirements: Retain lexemes before coercion, exact precision gate/clock evidence and alternate assertions. Reject float timestamp admission; no reparsing historical strings into false precision.

validation_profiles.title: Quantities and units
validation_profiles.requirements: Finite decimal strings and strict nonnegative counts; approved unit mappings/dimensions, comparators, percent/fraction and active component/activity conventions. Preserve raw unit.

validation_profiles.title: Enums and terminology
validation_profiles.requirements: Closed schema enums, raw source preservation and exact mapping version; unknown raw codes cannot masquerade as supported normalized clinical identity.

validation_profiles.title: Bounds and resources
validation_profiles.requirements: Versioned maximum arrays, raw waveform byte/rate windows, nesting/graph/runtime/retention limits. Explicit failure on cap exhaustion; no silent clinical truncation.

validation_profiles.title: Method and quality
validation_profiles.requirements: Required acquisition/method/quality/calibration/zeroing/compartment/sampling evidence appropriate to intended use; unsuitable source still recorded.

validation_profiles.title: Temporal applicability and coverage
validation_profiles.requirements: Interval overlap, source/admission cutoffs, source gaps and method-specific alignment; no implicit nearest-time mixing, rate carry-forward or absent-means-zero.

validation_profiles.title: Clinical governance
validation_profiles.requirements: Exact content payload, approval and feature activation, population scope, local parameters and independent validation evidence; drafts cannot execute.

validation_profiles.title: Write and lifecycle safety
validation_profiles.requirements: Durable command admission, exact payload/key, expected revision/context generation, worker fencing, owned unknown completion and explicit downstream guarantees.

validation_profiles.title: Rendering and disclosure
validation_profiles.requirements: Safe text/content rendering, protected references, accessible labels, no instructions executed from source text, decimal/time fidelity, crisp source age/uncertainty and keyboard screen use.

global_constraints: Compile closed schemas and DTOs with additionalProperties forbidden, known discriminator unions, target-kind/scope reference allowlists and conditional validators before implementation acceptance. This registry is a typed specification, not the compiled validator.
Patient, knowledge and operations scopes stay distinct; no fabricated patient for reference content.
Source fields immutable; canonical hash excludes its own digest and does not recursively expand references.
Authoritative forward relationships with reverse membership in projections; association cycles differ from acyclic derivation lineage.
Preserve old M7 wire contracts and exact retained history; no destructive migration or silently added timestamp precision.
Every numeric clinical profile and local threshold is disabled until independently authored/approved/validated.
